rows.why: keep 336.4 as the top of a **300-336 km/h band labelled assumed** (the 2026-10-23 sign-off covers the label, not a measurement) and do NOT tune drag to it: `land_aerodynamics.drag_coefficient` stays T-A2's class fit 0.55, so the pair is two decisions, not one translation; at T-E2's 2921 N.m x the 0.65 wash at 4500 rpm = 894.7 kW, Cd.A = 0.55 x 6.634667 = 3.649 m^2 and rho 1.2 the predicted terminal is (2P/(rho Cd A))^(1/3) = 74.2 m/s = 267 km/h (265 at rho 1.225) - the number a take compares with - while 93.44 m/s at the same power would need Cd.A = 1.828 m^2, i.e. Cd 0.276, also not written; the Cd 0.1213 this row used to carry was reverse-engineered from the label and is rejected/not written (0.1213 x 6.635 = 0.805 m^2 is only 394 kW at 93.44 m/s, not the 894.7 kW it cited, and the earlier 260 km/h did not follow from its own inputs - correction 8391); any top-speed take tests **reachability of a label, not fidelity to BmAK**; whether `official_top_speed` is a cap is UNKNOWN (`keep-audit-engine-boost-aero.md` T-E5)

decisions.question: Tyre diameter: keep the PSKX true scale (1.366 m measured) or scale the **whole car** so the tyre reads 1.40 m?
decisions.data: G1-18 → `Research/BatmobileGrab/TYRES.md`: tread Ø1.3652–1.3657, shoulder Ø1.371, all four wheels within 0.5 mm; 1.42 has no source (initial-commit docstring; the wheel `Disc` bone's own vertical extent is 1.427)
decisions.answer: **resolved 2026-10-24: keep the PSKX true scale** — the condition failed: 1.366 does exclude the shoulder, but the bulge is 5.5 mm, so the tyre with its shoulder reads 1.371, still 2.0% short of 1.40; the missing 34 mm to 1.40 is not in the mesh, so rescaling would move ride height, track and body by 2.5% to chase a wiki estimate

decisions.question: Pursuit/Battle: (a) two Rebel Drop entries, (b) one hybrid car, (c) research a runtime toggle first
decisions.answer: **REOPENED 2026-11-06 (research, task 8301): (b) withdrawn — awaiting the operator.** BmAK has **two modes** (`BattleMode*` 42 declared / 15 serialised, `TurningModeMaxSpeed` 600 cm/s, `TurnOnSpot*`, `Transformation*`) and **a hybrid cannot carry rows T-MD5, T-MD6, T-MD7, T-MD8, T-MD13 and T-MD14**: no JC3 member switches a handling value at runtime, and the only carrier that holds a second value set is a **second entity** (`tmp/freebuff/reports/mode-switch-carriers.md` §3/§6; audio: `tmp/freebuff/reports/battle-audio-switch-event.md` §4; the two rows that already turn on this switch: `tmp/freebuff/reports/keep-audit-world-modes.md` §3). Options now: **(a) two Rebel Drop entries, two entities of one chassis** — the only carrier for the six rows, cost = the swap trigger is UNKNOWN (§7 U1); **(b) keep the hybrid** and accept the six losses as declared omissions; **(c) a runtime selector** — no decoded selector in any module, entity graph or `.physicsc` (UNKNOWN, not planned). The two-mode plan (what flips, which member, which carrier, and every build step that changes) is `tmp/freebuff/reports/apply-mode-switch-rows.md`. Previous answer, kept as history and **no longer in force**: **resolved 2026-10-28 (user): (b) one hybrid car** — a single Rebel Drop entry carrying both modes; pursuit/battle switching is borrowed from JC3 functionality and altered to match BmAK. Until D-2 re-resolves, every approval that rests on the hybrid (audit A-02) is **provisional**, and B-12 is `todo: D-2 reopened`.
